name: Workflow Job Template Node Create Approval
description:
# Retrieve a Workflow Job Template Node:

Make GET request to this resource to retrieve a single workflow job template node
record containing the following fields:

* `timeout`: The amount of time (in seconds) before the approval node expires and fails. (integer)
* `name`: Name of this workflow approval template. (string)
* `description`: Optional description of this workflow approval template. (string)
* `context_template`: A Jinja2 template rendered with upstream set_stats artifacts when the approval is created. The result is stored on the approval as context_message and shown to the approver. (string)
* `required_approvals`: The number of distinct users that must approve before the node is considered approved. A single denial always denies the node. (integer)
* `on_timeout`: Whether the approval node is automatically approved or denied when the timeout expires. (choice)
    - `""`: ---------
    - `deny`: Deny
    - `approve`: Approve
